mathematics.assertion_tested: Solve fully coupled gated static radial equations in a finite exterior annulus at physical muK,Lstar,Mb with suppression u_R=4, verify original unclipped equations, flux and refinement. This probes finite-box existence only.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic identities over real positive symbols, then IEEE float64 numerics
mathematics.conventions: c=1,K=4piG, phi=Phi_phys/c^2, mu in Mpc^-1. Canonical a0 only. Flat gate S=exp(-u^3); spherical solves accepted only for Pi>=0. Reference-profile numbers are diagnostic substitutions, not on-shell galaxy solutions.
inputs: Point baryon source represented by inner (y-p)=1 atx1; innerZ and outerf,p fixed to reference; x1to60.
non_claims: No cosmological evolution or observed-galaxy fit
No global no-go from finite-box failure or from zero net asymptotic excess mass
No full GR health inference from static spatial symbol
No proof of whole parameter space viability or nonexistence
Trial gate clipping is rejected as evidence unless accepted solution passes original unclipped equations; large positive u underflows correctly
Only canonical footing; alternative a0 not pooled
Nonfinite residuals in rejected BVP attempts are retained as null plus explicit path/value, not numerical evidence.
